name: GT2 pulley, 20 teeth, 5 mm bore
source: Standard numbers for this part (datasheet / ISO / NEMA); not yet measured
notes: Fits a 6 mm GT2 belt. 12.7 mm pitch diameter (40 mm of belt per turn), 16 mm flanges, 16 mm long including the hub with two M3 set screws (2 mm hex key; tighten one onto the motor shaft's flat). Axis along z.
